blocked_sentences: {T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast colorless spells. Activate only if you control seven or more lands.

needs.what: a colour predicate inside a mana_restriction group, e.g. {"colorless": true}, so this ability's restriction can be {"cast": [[{"colorless": true}]]} -- the spell being cast must have no colours
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_restriction groups match only lowercased types/subtypes/supertypes (costs.spell_purpose builds SpendPurpose.names from types, subtypes and supertypes) plus the mana_value and x_in_mana_cost predicates (RESTRICTION_PREDICATES). Colour is not in SpendPurpose, so a literal "colorless" name matches nothing and makes the mana unspendable, and omitting the restriction funds every spell -- a strictly better card than printed. The 'activate only if you control seven or more lands' clause looks expressible as the ability's condition; the restriction alone blocks the line
